cases.name: compute-unknown-tag
cases.description: A tag the compute language has no meaning for

cases.description: <current/> where there is nothing being walked

cases.name: compute-unbound-var
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><compute><result><var name="ghost"/></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-wrong-arity
cases.description: <divide> with the wrong number of arguments
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><compute><result><divide><int v="10"/></divide></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-choose-without-otherwise
cases.description: A choose whose branches can all miss
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><compute><result><choose><when><test><equals><field name="A"/><int v="1"/></equals></test><then><str v="one"/></then></when></choose></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-shadowing-let

cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><compute><let name="x"><int v="1"/></let><let name="x"><int v="2"/></let><result><var name="x"/></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-unknown-encoding
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><compute><result><encode as="rot13"><field name="A"/></encode></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-missing-wrapper

cases.name: compute-two-results

cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><compute><result><int v="1"/></result><result><int v="2"/></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-field-out-of-scope

cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><compute><result><field name="Nope"/></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-unknown-predicate

cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><compute><result><choose><when><test><roughly><field name="A"/><int v="1"/></roughly></test><then><str v="x"/></then></when><otherwise><str v="y"/></otherwise></choose></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="hello"/></sequence><sequence name="M"><compute><result><mask><field name="A"/></mask></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{M}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: mask-with-a-pattern
cases.description: The same tag with a pattern is untouched
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="hello"/></sequence><sequence name="M"><compute><result><mask pattern="xx"><field name="A"/></mask></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{M}}</data></line></block></tdc>
